about.title: Who are we?
about.mission: At Solaris, we are building Mexico's energy future. We don't just install panels: we integrate complete clean energy systems, smart batteries, and electric vehicle chargers. Our goal is to lead the transition toward self-sufficient, connected homes and businesses prepared for the next 10 years of innovation.

q1.question: How do solar panels work?
q1.answer: The panels capture sunlight and convert it into electricity that you can use at home or business.

q2.question: How much can I save with solar panels?
q2.answer: It depends on your consumption, but most of our clients save between 70% and 98% on their bill.

q3.question: Do they require maintenance?
q3.answer: Only occasional cleaning and an annual inspection to ensure their efficiency.

q4.question: What can I power with backup batteries?
q4.answer: Refrigerator, lights, internet, security cameras, computer and more, even during power outages.

q5.question: How fast will my electric car charge?
q5.answer: It depends on the charger and car model, but typically between 2 and 6 hours with a Level 2 charger.
